Ayesha Kumar | ayesha.kumar565@example.com | +91 9854249803
Pune, Maharashtra
Early-career data engineer focused on building streaming and batch ETL pipelines using cloud and open-source tools. Notice period: 60 days.

Data Engineer, NimbusSoft — May 2025 - Jun 2026
Built and maintained real-time and batch data pipelines to ingest, process, and deliver event data for analytics and ML feature stores. Implemented Kafka-based ingestion with topic partitioning and retention policies to handle peak loads of 200k events/hour, using Kafka to decouple producers and consumers. Developed PySpark jobs on AWS EMR to transform raw events into optimized parquet datasets, improving downstream query performance by 35%. Automated ETL deployment and monitoring on AWS using S3 for storage, IAM roles for secure access, and CloudWatch alerts for job failures. Collaborated in Agile sprints with product and analytics teams to iterate on data models and deliverables.

Skills: Python, SQL, AWS, Kafka, PySpark, Linux, Agile

Education
B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
